title: Reconcile every closed issue including no-PR dispositions
goal: Persist authenticated terminal closeout for every closed issue, including approved no-PR dispositions, and accept complete GitHub closing-keyword syntax without weakening linkage checks.
required_outcome: Persist authenticated terminal closeout for every closed issue, including approved no-PR dispositions, and accept complete GitHub closing-keyword syntax without weakening linkage checks.
acceptance_criteria: Focused terminal cleanup tests: no-PR closed/retired/superseded/umbrella success, wrong identity/open issue/stale evidence/conflicting receipt failures; existing merged closeout regression and supported closing keywords. Then rerun the 199-issue audited closeout sweep.
validation_plan: Focused terminal cleanup tests: no-PR closed/retired/superseded/umbrella success, wrong identity/open issue/stale evidence/conflicting receipt failures; existing merged closeout regression and supported closing keywords. Then rerun the 199-issue audited closeout sweep.
demo_proof_requirements: Focused terminal cleanup tests: no-PR closed/retired/superseded/umbrella success, wrong identity/open issue/stale evidence/conflicting receipt failures; existing merged closeout regression and supported closing keywords. Then rerun the 199-issue audited closeout sweep.
non_goals: No fabricated PR or completion evidence, no reopening/closing remote issues, no forced cleanup, no release approval.
notes_risks: Operator-approved disposition must remain distinct from independent implementation proof.
